subject.title: [Feature]: Add deliveryCapabilities with full durableFinal to Feishu outbound adapter

question: Which durable-delivery features should the Feishu plugin promise after the core contract and Feishu API behavior are verified, rather than mirroring Telegram’s capability set?
rationale: The issue’s proposed full declaration includes capabilities not evidenced by current Feishu outbound code, so a human owner should confirm the intended durable contract before an implementation advertises behavior the plugin may not honor.

options.title: Audit and declare the verified subset
options.body: Add only capabilities proved by Feishu’s send paths and core retry contract, with focused regression tests.

options.title: Implement full parity first
options.body: Add the missing Feishu runtime behavior and API proof for every requested capability before declaring the full set.

options.title: Keep the current narrow contract
options.body: Retain text/media-only durable support if reliable retry preservation for the other features is not an intended Feishu guarantee.

recommendation.title: Audit and declare the verified subset
recommendation.body: Add only capabilities proved by Feishu’s send paths and core retry contract, with focused regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu plugin-boundary and message-routing history makes this the strongest available owner signal.
